detail.longDescription: I was looking at the definition of the SESV2Client from CDN and noticed that there was not a super call withing its constructor when it inherits from client. https://cdn.skypack.dev/-/@aws-sdk/client-sesv2@v3.1045.0-rI3W95zf8xrbBpGhgdxx/dist=es2019,mode=imports/optimized/@aws-sdk/client-sesv2.js . I noticed that super was not there previously when I examined the code. They changed it. The new error seems to be that super is called in the third line of the method. This person received a + 1 over a lie. Super is always needed in the constructor when you inherit.
